jobs.name: Hochzeit
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one reusable fantasy notice-board poster image, as a separate physical paper layer for an existing game website. Create ONE new isolated poster; input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Image 1 (Ankündigung) establishes simple flat warm ochre parchment with dark brown hand-inked outlines; image 2 (ARBEIT) establishes large bold legible German header and wavy placeholder body lines; image 3 (HOCHZEIT) establishes parchment and wedding ornament style ONLY. Match this modest illustrated paper series: matte warm ochre paper, subtle even grain, simple crisp irregular dark brown outlines, flat hand-inked decorative symbols, no realistic depth or ornate illuminated manuscript treatment. Full paper shown frontally, small gently worn/crooked edges, entire silhouette comfortably inside transparent canvas. TRUE transparent PNG alpha outside the paper, no backdrop or checkerboard. No nail, pin, tack, knife, fixing, hand, scene, board, photograph, or external drop shadow; shadows are added later by the app. The ONLY readable words may be the exact requested headline; all body content consists of 5–7 irregular wavy ink lines like the references, no pseudo-readable sentences. No names, proper nouns, dates, locations, guilds, heraldry, logo, watermark or extra labels. Subject: a general wedding announcement usable for any wedding. Broad landscape parchment sheet, approximately 1.6:1 paper aspect ratio; roses and two intertwined rings as simple brown ink ornaments, like the wedding reference. Large centered headline Text (verbatim): "HOCHZEIT". Below it a small empty decorative name panel with NO text, followed by wavy placeholder lines. Remove every reference-specific person name. This is a generic wedding design, no bride or groom portraits.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square 1:1 fantasy RPG inventory item illustration: a reusable generic notice-board parchment poster, a new sibling variant of the two attached poster artworks.
Input images: Reference 1 defines the flat parchment drawing language, warm ochre paper and dark brown hand-inked outlines; Reference 2 defines the larger poster drawing language and clean readability. Both are STYLE references only; do not copy their existing words. Match their hand-painted fantasy inventory style: crisp dark outlines, simplified matte shading, muted warm colors, subtle even paper grain, gentle illustrated highlights, readable shapes at small thumbnail size. Not photorealistic, not CGI or glossy 3D.
Composition: a SINGLE upright portrait paper approximately 2:3 shape, entirely visible front-on with slightly irregular edges; centered on a square transparent artboard, taking about 85% of height. Flat paper artwork, no 3D perspective. Bold legible dark-brown medieval serif headline at top, one simple relevant ink illustration beneath it, then four short wavy dark-brown placeholder lines near the bottom. Those lines are NOT words. An optional plain unbranded small wax seal may sit on the paper; no insignia.
TRUE transparent PNG alpha outside the paper, no environment, wall, wood, backdrop, painted checkerboard or floor, NO outer shadow or contact shadow, no glow or halo. NO nail, pin, tack, knife or attachment; a movable nail will be a separate UI layer. No extra objects outside the paper. No proper names, places, dates, house/guild emblems, specific quest details or watermark. Only the requested exact headline is readable text.
This explicit flat poster design with required headline overrides the generic inventory preset's no-text and three-quarter-view conventions.
Text (verbatim): "VERLOREN!". Spell it exactly as given, all uppercase, no other readable words.
Illustration: a simple open empty coin pouch with a single large question mark above it, drawn in the same dark-brown ink on the parchment. No specific owner.
